description: This file implements the MediaFrameWriterV1 class, which handles writing media frames and associated metadata into shared memory buffers for media streaming. It includes methods for writing generic metadata, type-specific metadata (audio/video), and media data, with logging and error handling.

classes.name: MediaFrameWriterV1
classes.description: A class responsible for writing media frames and metadata into shared memory buffers, supporting both metadata and media data for media streaming.

methods.name: MediaFrameWriterV1::writeFrame
methods.description: Writes a media segment into shared memory, including metadata and media data, and updates internal counters.

methods.name: MediaFrameWriterV1::writeMetaDataGeneric
methods.description: Writes generic metadata for a media segment, including data length, timestamp, ID, and extra data.

methods.name: MediaFrameWriterV1::writeMetaDataTypeSpecific
methods.description: Writes type-specific metadata (audio or video) for a media segment.

methods.name: MediaFrameWriterV1::writeData
methods.description: Writes the actual media data bytes into shared memory.
